name: drag-panel
title: Drag panel
description: An embedded panel that follows your pointer and settles with an interruptible spring. 嵌入页面的拖动面板。跟随手势，松手后弹簧回位，途中可再次抓住。

files.content:
Reading / interaction sample

A little room
for reading.

Drag the handle up. Let go, then catch the panel while it settles.

Light on the desk

Sample text · Replace with your content

The afternoon light moves from the page to the table. The room has not changed. What we notice has.
